links.comparator_used: Basic prompt (without the plain-language instructions) given to the same AI programs (ChatGPT, Gemini)
links.outcome: Readability (grade level from a panel of readability indices), plus understandability and actionability (PEMAT) of patient education materials
links.effect: Advanced plain-language prompt documents had mean readability scores at or below 6th grade and were significantly more readable than basic-prompt documents. ChatGPT with the advanced prompt had the lowest mean grade level (5.8; SD 0.84) and the highest PEMAT scores (91% understandable, 84% actionable). Both AIs with the advanced prompt exceeded the 70% actionability threshold. Numeric basic-prompt scores are not given in the abstract.
links.quote: Documents from generative AI using the advanced prompt and UpToDate had mean readability scores ≤ 6th grade, with significantly better readability than AI-generated documents using the basic prompt or HealthyChildren.org.
